## Problem
What are you trying to do that PluginVault doesn't let you do today?

## Proposed solution
How would you want this to work? Be specific — UI flow, buttons, menus.

## Alternatives considered
Other ways to solve this problem, including workarounds you're using now.

## Scope check
PluginVault is intentionally small and focused. We'll probably say no to:
- DAW integration
- Plugin preset management  
- Cloud sync
- Telemetry/analytics
- Plugin marketplace features

Is your request in scope? Why does it belong in a plugin manager?

## Additional context
Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools.
